verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for a workspace and agent-orchestration app like Conductor, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no feature for exporting all user data (chats, workspaces, settings) in open formats. Code living in git worktrees and an API that can read agent replies are host-platform or developer building blocks, not a first-party export capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
